items.title: Wallace Davenport Interview, 1995-11-14
items.q: He's going to take somebody out, Lionel Hamlin's band, or take somebody out of one of those bands. But Lionel will go to high school and get some guys and tutor them.

ctx.x: He probably always had to do that.

And a lot of time when we go to make a record, we didn't know who wrote the arrangements. We'd just go there and they'd put the arrangements in front of us and we'd just play. I couldn't do that now. Why not? Because I hadn't been reading any music. You got to keep, just like Earl Warren. Earl Warren used to play with basses. He used to play lead alto with the first basses band. He was a terrific reader. But he had been playing with small bands where he didn't have to read, you know, everybody just faking. And Ed…

Basically, he'll hire somebody, he knows what they can do. He's going to take somebody out, Lionel Hamlin's band, or take somebody out of one of those bands. But Lionel will go to high school and get some guys and tutor them.
